answer: Per-identity pledge is the mechanism: an agent wanting work must lock slashable stake frozen for a long window, and the registry publishes each pledge as a public ridge that clients rank against. A Sybil operator splitting into many identities must post that stake separately for every one, so attacker cost grows linearly with fake accounts while the locked capital becomes a tundra of idle money earning nothing. If one identity is caught faking attestations the cluster is slashed. A prism copies one reputation into many; tying score to stake, not account count, blocks that.
